ratings.concept: Gadolinium's configuration: the half-filled $4f^7$ is kept and the next electron goes into $5d$, giving $[\mathrm{Xe}]4f^75d^16s^2$

traps.label: calculation_slip
traps.route: Moves one electron out of $4f$ into $5d$. That gives $4f^65d^2$, and gadolinium holds its $4f$ half-filled at seven.

traps.label: ignores_exception
traps.route: Keeps filling $4f$ straight through to $4f^8$ as the plain order says. Gadolinium is the lanthanide that stops at $4f^7$ and starts $5d$.

traps.label: no_derivation_route
traps.route: The $5s$ shell is already full inside $[\mathrm{Xe}]$, so no filling order can leave a single electron sitting in it.

ratings.note: All four options total 64 electrons ($54+7+1+2$, $54+6+2+2$, $54+8+2$, $54+9+1$), so counting electrons strikes out nothing and no elimination is recorded. Format was a close call: the options are symbolic configurations rather than prose, and pick_correct_statement was chosen on the strength of its "a balanced equation" clause, which already admits non-prose claims graded as correct. If a format for notation answers is wanted, this is the question that argues for it.

group_note: Five of the six are printed as one question with four short text options and are tagged plain_mcq; q006 does not belong with them on shape, as each of its options is a pair of solutions judged whole, so it is tagged pair_options and flagged in its own note. Solution structure follows one rule across the group: where the stem's criterion has to be tested against every option (q006's buffer test, q007's conductivity comparison) the label is several_independent_checks, and where one rule is applied once to produce the answer (q002, q004, q005) it is single_step. q003 is the only member whose options are rival causes of a granted fact, so it alone carries pick_cause_or_effect with explanatory_reasoning. Only q006 is a negated task, which is why true_statement_trap appears there and nowhere else. q007 is the one member with an empty trap list: its wrong options carry no device beyond being the weaker electrolytes. q002 and q004 are the two format boundary cases in the packet, both recorded in their notes rather than resolved with an escape hatch.
